label: Успеть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for успеть (to have time, to make it in time).

missions.phrase: Я успею закончить работу до обеда.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first person. Успеть is perfective, so its non-past is future. 'Успею' is the 1sg perfective future, meaning 'I will manage in time', and governs the infinitive 'закончить'.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second person. 'Успеешь' is the 2sg perfective future of успеть with -ешь on the успе- stem. With 'на' plus accusative it means 'to make it in time for' the bus.

missions.phrase: Он не успеет всё сделать сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third person. 'Успеет' is the 3sg perfective future of успеть with -ет. Negated, it admits he will not manage to finish everything, governing the infinitive 'сделать'.

missions.phrase: Мы успеем выпить кофе перед поездом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Успеем' is the 1pl perfective future of успеть with -ем. It expresses just managing to fit something in, here a coffee before the train.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Успеют' is the 3pl perfective future of успеть with -ют, closing the non-past set. It governs the infinitive 'приехать' and means they will arrive in time.

missions.phrase: Я едва успел на важную встречу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Успел' is the past m. sg. of perfective успеть, reporting a completed action. 'Едва' stresses that I barely made it to the meeting.

missions.phrase: Она не успела предупредить нас вовремя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Успела' is the past f. sg. of успеть with -ла. Negated, it states she did not manage to warn us in time, governing the infinitive 'предупредить'.

missions.phrase: Студенты успели сдать работу в срок.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Успели' is the past pl. of успеть with -ли. The perfective marks a result achieved, handing in the work within the deadline.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Успей' is the informal command of успеть, formed from the future stem успе- plus -й. The perfective imperative urges getting something done before a deadline.

missions.phrase: Я хочу успеть на утренний рейс.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Успеть' is the bare perfective infinitive after 'хочу', expressing the wish to make it in time. Its imperfective partner is успевать, used for the habitual sense.
